about.autoUpdatesHint: Signet looks for a new version at launch, then every few hours.

appearance.note: The Dock icon changes right away; the Finder icon stays Aurore.

appearance.layoutHintNoKeys: Choose between a sidebar and a row of tabs at the top of the window.

appearance.themeHint: Applies to the interface and to websites that support it.

appearance.transparencyHint: Let the desktop show through the sidebar and floating panels.
appearance.densityHint: Height of tab rows in the sidebar.
appearance.textSizeHint: Size of the interface text (web pages keep their own zoom).
appearance.tabPreviewHint: A card shows the page, its title and address when you pause on a tab.

boosts.confirm: Delete the Boost for {{site}}? Its CSS and hidden elements will be lost.
boosts.empty1: A Boost customizes a site: free-form CSS, presets (dark mode, system font…) and hidden elements.
boosts.empty2: Open a site then press <kbd>{{keys}}</kbd> to create the first one.
boosts.empty2NoKeys: Open a site, then use Customize This Site in the page menu to create the first one.

extensions.confirm: Remove “{{name}}”? Its data will be deleted.

extensions.confirmUnpacked: Remove “{{name}}”? Its folder stays on disk.

general.sleepAfter: Put hidden tabs to sleep after
general.sleepAfterHint: A sleeping tab frees its memory and reloads when you come back to it. A tab that is shown, playing sound or in picture in picture never sleeps.
general.archiveAfterHint: Inactive tabs join the archived tabs.
general.compactHint: Hides the sidebar and toolbar; they come back when you move to the edges ({{keys}}).
general.compactHintNoKeys: Hides the sidebar and toolbar; they come back when you move to the edges.
general.newTabPositionHint: Where new tabs appear among Today tabs. With tabs at the top of the window: left or right.
general.peekLinks: Open external links from pinned tabs in Peek
general.pipHint: A playing video switches to picture in picture when you change tabs, or leave the window for another app or desktop.
general.confirmQuitHint: Hold ⌘Q or press it twice to quit.
general.askDownloadPath: Ask where to save each file
general.askDownloadPathHint: A window opens for each download to pick the folder and the name.
general.searchEngineHint: Used when you type a search in the address bar.
general.siteLanguagesHint: Sent to websites in order of preference; by default, the system languages.
general.swipe: Swipe with two fingers to navigate
general.swipeHint: Swipe right on a page to go back, left to go forward.
general.bookmarksBarHint: Below the address bar ({{keys}}). Each space has its own bookmarks.
general.spellcheckHint: Underlines mistakes in website text fields; right-click to see suggestions.
general.githubTokenHint: For pull request folders: a classic token with the “repo” scope, or a fine-grained token with read access to pull requests. It stays encrypted on this computer.
general.githubTokenFailed: The token could not be saved or removed. Try again.
general.bookmarksBarHintNoKeys: Below the address bar. Each space has its own bookmarks.

import.note: Some sources require Signet to have Full Disk Access (System Settings › Privacy & Security › Full Disk Access).
import.failed: The import did not complete. Try again.
import.chooseHint: Choose what to import. Open tabs and cookies are not imported.
import.passwordsHint: The system may ask you to allow access to the browser’s key.
import.extensionsHint: Downloaded from the Chrome Web Store.

languages.note: The primary language fully applies at next launch.

privacy.confirmAll: Clear history, archived tabs, downloads list, cache, cookies, data and permissions of all sites? You will be signed out of sites.
privacy.permEmpty: No saved choices. Sites that ask for the camera, location or notifications will appear here.

routing.note: New tabs opened from the command bar and links received from other apps open in the chosen space. A domain covers its subdomains; * matches any sequence of characters (*.notion.site).

desc.boosts: Boosts customize a single site: your own CSS, presets such as dark mode, and hidden elements.
desc.routing: Routing makes a site always open in the space you choose.

item.goToTab: Go to tab 1 to 8 (9: last tab)
item.tabLayout: Tabs on top / on the side

shortcuts.recordingHint: Esc to cancel, Backspace to remove the shortcut.
shortcuts.confirmReset_one: Reset your {{count}} custom shortcut to its default?
shortcuts.confirmReset_other: Reset your {{count}} custom shortcuts to their defaults?
shortcuts.needModifierOther: Add Ctrl or Alt to the key.
shortcuts.unsupported: This key can't be used as a shortcut.

passwords.managerOffHint: Signet neither saves nor fills passwords.
passwords.managerExtHint: {{name}} takes care of your passwords. Signet no longer offers to save or fill them.
passwords.extensionInstalledHint: Sign in to your account from its button in the toolbar.
passwords.extensionMissingHint: Installed from the Chrome Web Store.
passwords.offerHint: After you sign in, Signet offers to save the password you typed. Never in private windows.
passwords.noEncryption: Encryption isn’t available on this system: no password can be saved.
passwords.leftover_one: {{count}} password is still in Signet’s keychain. Export it to import it into your manager.
passwords.leftover_other: {{count}} passwords are still in Signet’s keychain. Export them to import them into your manager.
passwords.importHint: CSV file exported from Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass, Proton Pass or Dashlane
passwords.importNothing: No password found in this file.

importError.format: File not recognised: it needs a column for the site address and one for the password.
importError.read: The file could not be read.
importError.encryption: Passwords can’t be saved: this system can’t encrypt them.

passwords.exportFailed: The passwords could not be exported.
passwords.loadFailed: The saved passwords could not be read. Check that the system keychain is available.
passwords.exported: Passwords exported. The file isn’t encrypted: delete it once you’ve used it.
passwords.empty: No saved passwords. Sign in to a site, or import them from another browser.
passwords.confirmDelete: Delete the password for {{user}} on {{site}}? This cannot be undone.
passwords.touchIdNote: Your system authentication (Touch ID, account password or Windows Hello) is required to show, copy or export a password.

mods.disableAllHint: If a mod gets in the way: also in the View menu, or by launching Signet with --safe-mode.

mods.confirmDelete: Delete the mod “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
mods.name: Mod name
mods.liveHint: Applied to the whole interface as soon as you save (⌘S).
mods.offHint: Mods are off: this one will apply when you turn them back on.
mods.empty: No mods yet. A mod is a CSS sheet that changes how Signet looks, never websites.
mods.help: Useful hooks: --h (space hue), --accent, --bg, --surface; html.route-main (main window), html.route-settings, .sidebar, .toolbar, .tabstrip, .bm-bar, .palette. List order is the order mods apply in.

apps.empty1: A site installed as an app opens in its own window, without tabs or sidebar, and launches from the Dock, Launchpad or Spotlight.
apps.empty2: Open a site, then choose File › Install This Site as App…
apps.intro: Launchers are in {{folder}}: drag them to the Dock or open them from Spotlight.
apps.howTo: To install another site: File › Install This Site as App…, or right-click the page or its tab.
apps.recreate: Recreate the launcher and show it in Finder
apps.confirm: Uninstall “{{name}}”? Its launcher will be deleted.

developer.devModeHint: Develop menu (cache, JavaScript, theme, network, user agent…). On local pages (localhost, 127.0.0.1, *.local, *.test, local network): the port in the address bar and the number of console errors and warnings; click the counter to open the console.
developer.keepOut: Keep local pages out of history
developer.keepOutHint: They no longer appear in history or in command bar suggestions.
developer.shortcutsHint: Developer tools {{devtools}} · JavaScript console {{console}} · Responsive design mode {{responsive}}
developer.jsonViewerHint: JSON responses show as a collapsible tree, with search, raw and pretty views.
developer.aliasesHint: A short name for a local server: type “mysite” (or “mysite/admin”) in the command bar to open localhost:3000, and the address bar shows “mysite”. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, optionally ending in .test or .localhost; local addresses only.

developer.aliasBadTarget: Invalid address: a local address (localhost, 127.0.0.1, *.local, *.test, local network), or just a port.

backup.modeAddHint: Nothing is deleted; anything already there isn't added twice.

backup.restartNote: Signet restarts after an import. A safety copy of your current data, passwords included, is made just before.
backup.safetyHint: The last 3 are kept. Saved passwords stay encrypted by your system and can only be restored on this computer.
backup.safetyLoaded: Safety copy loaded: the “Replace” mode is selected. Check it, then import to go back to this state.

recovery.message: The interface ran into a problem. Your tabs are safe.
